user_query: I need to fetch the latest training-cluster utilisation metrics from the H200 fleet and have them written to the team's status channel.

function.name: h200_fleet_metrics
function.description: Retrieve hourly utilisation, temperature, and idle-percentage metrics for the H200 GPU fleet rolled up by cluster.

function.name: post_status_update
function.description: Post a formatted status update to a named channel (Slack-compatible).

user_query: Please open a new MCP server registration for our internal payments toolset, name it acme-payments-mcp.

function.name: mcp_register_server
function.description: Register a new Model Context Protocol server with the platform registry. The registry resolves server names to TLS endpoints and tool inventories.

user_query: Run a quick capability sweep against the new GPT-5.5-pro endpoint and tell me if it can handle the long-context summarisation case.

function.name: capability_sweep_run
function.description: Execute a fixed capability-sweep harness against an LLM endpoint and return per-capability pass/fail.

user_query: Rebalance the spot allocation on the inference autoscaler in eu-west-3 to favour 30% on-demand.

function.name: autoscaler_rebalance
function.description: Adjust the spot/on-demand mix on a regional inference autoscaler. Triggers a rolling rebalance over the next two scaling cycles.

user_query: I want to disable the experimental thinking budget on the Sonnet 4.6 deployment for the support tier.

function.name: deployment_set_thinking
function.description: Toggle or budget the extended-thinking channel on a hosted-model deployment. Setting budget=0 disables thinking entirely.

user_query: Pull the current GEPA optimisation trace for the customer-onboarding prompt and show me the Pareto front.

function.name: gepa_trace_load
function.description: Load a saved GEPA (Genetic-Pareto) prompt-optimisation trace and return the front of {prompt, score} pairs.

user_query: Promote the staging build of the orchestration agent to canary in the US-West region.

function.name: agent_promote
function.description: Promote a built agent artefact from one rollout stage to the next (dev -> staging -> canary -> prod) in a target region.

user_query: Generate an updated SBOM for the model-server image we shipped yesterday.

function.name: image_sbom_regenerate
function.description: Regenerate the Software Bill of Materials for a container image, including model weight provenance.

user_query: I need a fresh provider-routing report for our top 5 OpenRouter slugs, last 7 days.

function.name: openrouter_routing_report
function.description: Compile a per-slug provider-routing share report for a given window, useful for reproducibility audits.

user_query: Please rotate the Anthropic key on the eval pipeline and seal the old one.

function.name: secret_rotate_anthropic
function.description: Rotate the Anthropic API key for a named pipeline and atomically seal the old key in the rotation log.

user_query: Schedule a re-evaluation of the long-context QA suite against Gemini 3.1 Pro at 8AM tomorrow.

function.name: eval_schedule
function.description: Schedule a future eval-suite run against a model endpoint at a given timestamp.

user_query: Produce a cross-provider failure-mode report for last week's tool-call traffic.

function.name: tool_call_failure_report
function.description: Aggregate failure modes (rate-limit, schema-rejection, provider-timeout, etc.) across every provider for a window of tool-call traffic.

user_query: Push a new Kimi K2.6 routing rule that drops the call to the cheapest hosted provider whenever latency goes over 4 seconds.

function.name: router_rule_create
function.description: Create a routing rule on the multi-provider gateway that triggers when a metric crosses a threshold and routes calls to a chosen provider.

user_query: Generate a minimum reproducible failure for the function-calling regression we hit on Wednesday.

function.name: incident_minrepro
function.description: Build a minimum reproducible test case from an incident's traces.

user_query: Mint a one-time benchmark-replay token for the regression suite.

function.name: benchmark_replay_token
function.description: Issue a one-time replay token bound to a registered benchmark suite.
